Para la prueba online desde dos disposit: For the online test from two devices, the server has to be on the internet with an encrypted connection (the website uses https and browsers don't let an https page connect to an unencrypted server). Where do we put it? (a) On a cloud host with an account of yours: I prepare the server and the steps, you create the account and, if it's paid, choose the plan. (b) On your PC for the duration of the test, with a tunnel that gives it an https address: no hosting account needed, but it only works while your PC is on. The comparison of hosts and prices for the real game will be made with the data from the 100-player measurement.

Presencia de jugadores en la lógica pura: Player presence in the pure logic (src/logica/presencia.js): each client sends its position, facing and animation 10 times per second; the server stamps it with the connection's author and its own time, and every 100 ms sends each player the ones that have changed.
Los demás se dibujan 200 ms en el pasado: Other players are drawn 200 ms in the past, blending between the two states around that moment; turning takes the short way round and, if nothing arrives, the last direction is followed for at most 250 ms and then they stop.
La hora de cada estado sale del reloj de: Each state's time comes from the client's clock converted to the server's (using the fastest message), never in the future nor more than 1 s old: with the arrival time, network jitter caused jumps of up to 12 times the expected step in the test.
Al conectar, la bienvenida dice quién es: On connecting, the welcome message says who is there and where; when someone leaves, they disappear for the others. A broken state (NaN, absurdly far away, odd animation) gets an error and is not passed on.
Decisión provisional (el GDD no lo dice): Provisional decision (the GDD does not say): a 200 ms delay when drawing other players and at most 250 ms of prediction.

Los trozos se hacen en un hilo aparte (W: Chunks are built in a separate thread (Web Worker): heights, colours and ground shading off the drawing thread, a few chunks per frame, and the game does not stall while walking. Measure the longest frame when crossing edges, on PC and mobile
